text: A ceiling he knows. His own. Oakstead. Daylight, wrong-angled — he's lost hours, maybe a day. His whole left temple aches, cold, like frost that won't melt.
There's a mirror. He shouldn't look. He looks. Fine silver-white lines branch from his brow like cracked glass, faintly lit.

speaker: Kai
text: That's on my face. That's ON MY FACE.
And a stranger stands in the doorway of his own home — travel-worn, unhurried, wearing a crest Kai's only ever seen on coins.

speaker: Envoy
text: Kai of Oakstead. You woke a light that half the Reach saw. There is a law about that — older than your town, older than mine.

speaker: Envoy
text: You're coming to Vael Academy. I'm not here to ask. I'm here to make sure you arrive.

speaker: Kai
text: I forage mushrooms. I don't— there's clearly been a mistake, and it's got my face on it.

speaker: Envoy
text: No mistake. That's the trouble. Say your goodbyes, boy. We leave at first light.
